content.rendered:
I don’t know much about the source of today’s video; perhaps some Bon Jovi fans can help me.

The original Youtube poster cites this as hailing from Jon Bon Jovi’s sole stop in Japan on his 1997 Destination Anywhere tour, and I have no reason doubt that.

If so, however, someone needs to correct the setlist record, because there’s no mention of Jon’s beautiful cover of Bruce’s “Fade Away” below.

Interestingly, though, the setlist archive indicates that John opened the show with “Not Fade Away” (an entirely different Buddy Holly song) and encored with Bruce’s “Hearts of Stone.” Perhaps one of those is a mistaken reference to “Fade Away” instead.

Regardless of where it was, though, Jon gave a lovely and faithful performance of the song that night, and it’s a worthy addition to the vast catalog of Springsteen covers.

© May 3, 2019

excerpt.rendered: From his Destination Anywhere tour in 1997, Jon Bon Jovi treats Japanese fans to a faithful cover of Bruce Springsteen’s “Fade Away.”

jetpack-related-posts.title: Not Fade Away
jetpack-related-posts.author: Ken
jetpack-related-posts.excerpt: Bruce covered "Not Fade Away" as far back as 1971 and as recently as last summer. It's always at the ready for an impromptu team-up--watch some of best ones inside.

jetpack-related-posts.title: Fade Away
jetpack-related-posts.author: Ken
jetpack-related-posts.excerpt: "Fade Away" is a young man's "Back in Your Arms," a Danny Federici-powered cry of anguish over lost love. It's beautiful and perfect--Bruce's songwriting at its best.

jetpack-related-posts.title: Southside Johnny: Fade Away
jetpack-related-posts.author: Ken
jetpack-related-posts.excerpt: Southside Johnny turns in a gorgeously soulful, acoustic cover of "Fade Away."

jetpack-related-posts.title: Baby, Don’t Go
jetpack-related-posts.author: Ken
jetpack-related-posts.excerpt: Listen in on an abandoned River-era demo that might have been an early ancestor of "Fade Away."

jetpack-related-posts.title: Roll of the Dice: Fade to Black
jetpack-related-posts.author: Ken
jetpack-related-posts.excerpt: This Nebraska-era demo uses cinematic vocabulary to devastating effect.

jetpack-related-posts.title: Slow Fade
jetpack-related-posts.author: Ken
jetpack-related-posts.excerpt: Still missing in action after all these years: whatever happened to the smoking E Street Band song known only as "Slow Fade" from bootleg rehearsal tapes? Take a listen to this remarkable track inside.
